page.title: 条件に備える表現の道具箱

analysis.summaryJa: このページは条件表現を『想定・継続条件・事前の備え・別結果・予防』という心の仕事別に整理する。givenは既知の事情を考慮し、as long asは条件が続く範囲を示し、suppose/supposingは仮の前提を置く。in caseは出来事の前に準備し、otherwiseは前の行動がない場合の別結果を示す。for fear thatとlestは望ましくない事態を防ぐ形式的表現として扱う。
grammarPoints: given (that)で既知の事実を判断材料にすること
as long asで許可・状態が続く条件を示すこと
suppose/supposingで想像上の前提を置くこと
in caseで将来の可能性に備えて先に行動すること
otherwiseで『そうでなければ』という別結果を示すこと
for fear that / lestで望ましくない結果を予防すること
visualEvidence: 条件の道具箱にGIVEN・AS LONG AS・SUPPOSE・IN CASE・OTHERWISEが用途別に収納されている
GIVENのカードが既知の事情を判断台へ運んでいる
AS LONG ASの長い線が条件の継続範囲を示している
IN CASEの備品が出来事より前の準備を表している
OTHERWISEの分岐が行動しない場合の別結果へ向かう
予防表現の盾が恐れる結果を手前で止めている
commonTraps: in caseを単純なifと同じく事態発生後の条件と読む
givenを想像上のsupposeと混同する
as long asを時間の長さだけで解釈する
otherwiseの前後の論理を逆にする
for fear thatの後に確定を表すmustを置く
lestの後で三単現や過去形を使う

questions.prompt: ------- the recent increase in orders, the warehouse will add an evening shift.

choices.A: Supposing
choices.B: Otherwise
choices.C: Given
choices.D: In case

questions.translationJa: 最近の注文増加を考慮すると、倉庫は夕方のシフトを追加します。
questions.explanationJa: 後ろの既知の事実を判断材料として受けるためGivenが適切です。

questions.prompt: Employees may use the rooftop terrace ------- they keep the emergency exit clear.

choices.A: as long as
choices.B: in case
choices.C: otherwise
choices.D: given that

questions.translationJa: 非常口をふさがない限り、従業員は屋上テラスを利用できます。
questions.explanationJa: 許可が継続する条件を示すためas long asを使います。

questions.prompt: ------- the client requests delivery one week earlier—could production still meet the date?

choices.A: Given
choices.B: Otherwise
choices.C: In case
choices.D: Suppose

questions.translationJa: 顧客が配送を1週間早めるよう求めたと仮定しましょう。それでも生産は期日に間に合いますか。
questions.explanationJa: 仮の前提を想像して検討を始めるためSupposeが適切です。

questions.prompt: Take a printed copy of the itinerary ------- the airport Wi-Fi is unavailable.

choices.A: if only
choices.B: in case
choices.C: otherwise
choices.D: as long as

questions.translationJa: 空港のWi-Fiが利用できない場合に備えて、旅程表の印刷物を持っていってください。
questions.explanationJa: 今の時点で準備して将来の可能性に備えるためin caseを使います。

questions.prompt: Submit the expense report by noon; -------, payment will move to next month's cycle.

choices.A: otherwise
choices.B: given
choices.C: supposing
choices.D: as long as

questions.translationJa: 正午までに経費報告書を提出してください。そうでなければ、支払いは翌月の処理になります。
questions.explanationJa: 前の指示が実行されない場合の別結果を示すためotherwiseです。

questions.prompt: The samples were sealed carefully for fear that moisture ------- enter the containers.

choices.A: must
choices.B: will
choices.C: might
choices.D: has

questions.translationJa: 湿気が容器内に入ることを恐れて、試料は注意深く密封されました。
questions.explanationJa: for fear thatの後では、避けたい可能性を表すmightが自然です。

questions.prompt: ------- that fuel prices remain at this level, the proposed route is still economical.

choices.A: In case
choices.B: Given
choices.C: Otherwise
choices.D: Lest

questions.translationJa: 燃料価格がこの水準のままだという事情を考慮しても、提案ルートはなお経済的です。
questions.explanationJa: 既知または前提として認めた事実から判断するためGiven thatです。

questions.prompt: You may exchange shifts ------- your supervisor approves the change in advance.

choices.A: supposing
choices.B: otherwise
choices.C: in case
choices.D: as long as

questions.translationJa: 上司が事前に変更を承認する限り、シフトを交換できます。
questions.explanationJa: 許可を維持する条件を示すas long asが最適です。

questions.prompt: ------- the conference center loses power during the presentation; what is our backup plan?

choices.A: Given that
choices.B: As long as
choices.C: Supposing
choices.D: Otherwise

questions.translationJa: プレゼン中に会議場が停電したと仮定しましょう。代替案は何ですか。
questions.explanationJa: 想像上の前提を置いて対策を考えるためSupposingを使います。

questions.prompt: The legal team removed personal details lest the document ------- confidential information.

choices.A: reveals
choices.B: reveal
choices.C: revealed
choices.D: will reveal

questions.translationJa: 法務チームは文書が機密情報を明らかにしないよう、個人情報を削除しました。
questions.explanationJa: 形式的なlestの後では、避けたい結果を表す動詞原形revealを用います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence considering a known fact.

choices.A: Given that the limited seating, advance registration is recommended.
choices.B: Given the limited seating, advance registration is recommended.
choices.C: In case the limited seating, advance registration is recommended.
choices.D: Otherwise the limited seating, advance registration is recommended.

questions.translationJa: 座席数が限られていることを考慮し、事前登録をお勧めします。
questions.explanationJa: Givenの後に名詞句the limited seatingを置く構造が正しい文です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence stating a continuing condition.

choices.A: You may keep the equipment otherwise you store it securely.
choices.B: You may keep the equipment in case you will store it securely.
choices.C: You may keep the equipment as long as storing it securely you.
choices.D: You may keep the equipment as long as you store it securely.

questions.translationJa: 安全に保管する限り、その機器を引き続き使用できます。
questions.explanationJa: as long as＋主語＋動詞で、許可の継続条件を正しく示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence introducing an imagined premise.

choices.A: Suppose the supplier cannot meet the deadline; which backup vendor should we contact?
choices.B: Given the supplier cannot meet the deadline; it is already a confirmed fact suppose.
choices.C: Otherwise the supplier cannot meet the deadline; which backup vendor should we contact?
choices.D: Suppose if the supplier cannot meet the deadline; which backup vendor should we contact?

questions.translationJa: 仕入先が期限に間に合わないと仮定しましょう。どの代替業者へ連絡すべきですか。
questions.explanationJa: Suppose＋節で仮の前提を置く形が正しく、Suppose ifの重複は不要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing preparation.

choices.A: Bring the purchase order if the vendor will ask to see it in advance preparation.
choices.B: Bring the purchase order otherwise the vendor asks to see it.
choices.C: Bring the purchase order in case the vendor asks to see it.
choices.D: Bring the purchase order as long as the vendor asks to see it.

questions.translationJa: 業者から提示を求められる場合に備えて、発注書を持参してください。
questions.explanationJa: in caseは、要求が起きる前に発注書を準備する意味を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence showing a different outcome.

choices.A: Verify the bank details; in case, the transfer could go to the wrong account.
choices.B: Verify the bank details; given, the transfer could go to the wrong account.
choices.C: Verify the bank details; as long as, the transfer could go to the wrong account.
choices.D: Verify the bank details; otherwise, the transfer could go to the wrong account.

questions.translationJa: 銀行情報を確認してください。そうでなければ、送金先を誤る可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: otherwiseは独立した副詞として、前の行動をしない場合の結果を導きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a preventive purpose.

choices.A: The files were encrypted for fear unauthorized users must accessed them.
choices.B: The files were encrypted for fear that unauthorized users might access them.
choices.C: The files were encrypted otherwise unauthorized users might access them.
choices.D: The files were encrypted for fear that unauthorized users access them yesterday.

questions.translationJa: 無許可の利用者にアクセスされることを恐れて、ファイルは暗号化されました。
questions.explanationJa: for fear that＋mightで避けたい可能性を自然に表しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with lest.

choices.A: The technician labeled every cable lest anyone connect it incorrectly.
choices.B: The technician labeled every cable lest anyone connects it incorrectly.
choices.C: The technician labeled every cable in case of anyone connect it incorrectly.
choices.D: The technician labeled every cable otherwise anyone connecting it incorrectly.

questions.translationJa: 誰かが誤って接続しないよう、技術者はすべてのケーブルにラベルを付けました。
questions.explanationJa: 形式的なlest節では動詞原形connectを用います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct contrast between if and in case.

choices.A: We will order more chairs in case registrations exceeded capacity only after it happens, but we reserved nothing.
choices.B: We will order more chairs otherwise registrations exceed capacity, but in case means the same completed result.
choices.C: We will order more chairs if registrations exceed capacity, but we reserved a second room in case that happens.
choices.D: We will order more chairs if registrations will exceed capacity, but we reserved a second room otherwise that happens.

questions.translationJa: 登録が定員を超えれば椅子を追加注文しますが、そうなる場合に備えて第2会場を予約済みです。
questions.explanationJa: ifは条件成立後の対応、in caseは成立前の備えを表し、両者を正しく対比しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence based on a stated circumstance.

choices.A: Given the road is under repair that, the delivery estimate is reasonable.
choices.B: Supposing that the road is under repair as a confirmed circumstance otherwise.
choices.C: In case that the road is under repair, the delivery estimate is reasonable because it is known.
choices.D: Given that the road is under repair, the delivery estimate is reasonable.

questions.translationJa: 道路が工事中だという事情を考慮すると、その配送見積もりは妥当です。
questions.explanationJa: Given that＋完全な節で、既知の事情を判断材料にしています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct formal prevention sentence.

choices.A: The audit team retained copies lest any evidence be lost.
choices.B: The audit team retained copies lest any evidence was lost.
choices.C: The audit team retained copies as long as any evidence be lost.
choices.D: The audit team retained copies otherwise any evidence losing.

questions.translationJa: 証拠が失われないよう、監査チームは写しを保管しました。
questions.explanationJa: lestの後に原形beを置く形式的な予防表現です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Given the traffic conditions, the driver's delay is understandable."

choices.A: The driver caused the traffic conditions by arriving early.
choices.B: The delay is understandable only if there was no traffic.
choices.C: The traffic conditions are being imagined rather than treated as relevant facts.
choices.D: Considering the traffic conditions, it is reasonable that the driver was late.

questions.translationJa: 交通状況を考慮すると、運転手が遅れたのは理解できます。
questions.explanationJa: GivenはConsideringと同様、事情を判断材料として扱います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "You can use the studio as long as you leave it clean."

choices.A: You may use the studio even if you leave it dirty.
choices.B: Leaving the studio clean is the continuing condition for permission to use it.
choices.C: Cleaning the studio is forbidden after use.
choices.D: Permission ends before anyone enters the studio.

questions.translationJa: スタジオを清潔にしておくことが、利用許可の継続条件です。
questions.explanationJa: as long asは許可が保たれる条件を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Suppose the shipment is delayed—how should we notify customers?"

choices.A: The shipment has certainly arrived and no notice is needed.
choices.B: Customers have already caused the shipment to be delayed.
choices.C: Imagine that the shipment is delayed and consider the appropriate notification.
choices.D: A delay is impossible under every circumstance.

questions.translationJa: 荷物が遅れたと仮定し、適切な顧客通知を考えてください。
questions.explanationJa: Supposeは事実を断定せず、検討用の前提を想像させます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Carry a spare key in case the electronic lock fails."

choices.A: Carry a spare key now as preparation for a possible lock failure.
choices.B: Wait until the electronic lock fails before obtaining any key.
choices.C: The electronic lock will fail because you carry a spare key.
choices.D: Use the spare key only if the lock has already been repaired.

questions.translationJa: 電子錠の故障の可能性に備え、今のうちに予備鍵を持ってください。
questions.explanationJa: in caseは事態が起きる前の準備を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Confirm the booking today; otherwise, the quoted rate may expire."

choices.A: Confirming today will definitely cancel the quoted rate.
choices.B: If you do not confirm today, the quoted rate may expire.
choices.C: The rate expired before the booking was offered.
choices.D: The booking remains unchanged regardless of confirmation.

questions.translationJa: 今日確認しなければ、提示料金が失効する可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: otherwiseは『そうでなければ』という否定条件に言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The team lowered its voice for fear that it might disturb the interview."

choices.A: The team wanted the interview to become louder.
choices.B: The interview had ended before the team arrived.
choices.C: The team was required to interrupt the interview.
choices.D: The team spoke more quietly to avoid possibly disturbing the interview.

questions.translationJa: 面接を邪魔する可能性を避けるため、チームは声を落としました。
questions.explanationJa: for fear thatは避けたい結果を予防する目的を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Given that all seats are reserved, a waiting list is necessary."

choices.A: Because all seats are already reserved, a waiting list is needed.
choices.B: A waiting list will make every reserved seat disappear.
choices.C: Seats may be reserved only after the waiting list closes.
choices.D: The statement asks us to imagine that no seat is reserved.

questions.translationJa: すべての席がすでに予約済みなので、キャンセル待ち名簿が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: Given thatはここで既知の事情を理由・判断材料として示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "You may remain in the lounge as long as your train is delayed."

choices.A: You must leave the lounge whenever the train is delayed.
choices.B: The lounge causes the train to be delayed.
choices.C: Your continued stay is permitted during the period in which the train remains delayed.
choices.D: You may enter only after the train departs on time.

questions.translationJa: 列車の遅延が続く間は、ラウンジに滞在し続けられます。
questions.explanationJa: as long asは条件が継続する範囲を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Keep the original packaging; otherwise, we cannot accept a return."

choices.A: Keeping the packaging makes every return unacceptable.
choices.B: We can accept a return only if the original packaging is kept.
choices.C: Returns are accepted whether or not packaging exists.
choices.D: The packaging can be discarded before the return is approved.

questions.translationJa: 元の梱包を保管している場合に限り、返品を受け付けられます。
questions.explanationJa: otherwiseの警告から、梱包保持が必要条件だと分かります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The engineers used a shield lest nearby equipment be affected."

choices.A: The shield was designed to affect nearby equipment.
choices.B: Nearby equipment had to be removed because the shield failed.
choices.C: The engineers used a shield to prevent possible effects on nearby equipment.
choices.D: The engineers wanted the effect to become stronger.

questions.translationJa: 近くの機器への影響を防ぐため、技術者たちは遮蔽板を使いました。
questions.explanationJa: lestは起きてほしくない結果を避ける目的を表します。

questions.prompt: The city has announced major roadwork near the convention center. ------- the expected congestion, attendees should allow an extra thirty minutes.

choices.A: Given
choices.B: Suppose
choices.C: Otherwise
choices.D: In case

questions.translationJa: 市は会議場付近の大規模道路工事を発表しました。予想される混雑を考慮し、参加者は30分余分に見込むべきです。
questions.explanationJa: 既に分かっている混雑事情を判断材料にするためGivenです。

questions.prompt: The company permits flexible start times. Employees may arrive between 7:00 and 10:00 ------- they work the required hours.

choices.A: otherwise
choices.B: in case
choices.C: as long as
choices.D: supposing

questions.translationJa: 会社は柔軟な始業時刻を認めています。所定時間働く限り、従業員は7時から10時の間に出社できます。
questions.explanationJa: 柔軟制度が成立し続ける条件をas long asで示します。

questions.prompt: The outdoor reception depends on the weather. ------- heavy rain forces us indoors—can the ballroom hold everyone?

choices.A: Given
choices.B: Suppose
choices.C: Otherwise
choices.D: As long as

questions.translationJa: 屋外レセプションは天候次第です。大雨で屋内開催になったと仮定しましょう。宴会場は全員を収容できますか。

choices.A: unless

choices.C: as long as
choices.D: in case

questions.translationJa: プレゼンには大きな動画ファイルが複数含まれます。ホテルの回線が遅い場合に備え、退社前にダウンロードしてください。
questions.explanationJa: 将来の可能性に備えて今行動するためin caseです。

questions.prompt: Your security badge expires this evening. Renew it before departure; -------, you will not be able to enter tomorrow.

choices.A: given
choices.B: supposing
choices.C: otherwise
choices.D: as long as

questions.translationJa: セキュリティバッジは今夜失効します。退社前に更新してください。そうでなければ明日入館できません。
questions.explanationJa: 前の指示を実行しない場合の別結果をotherwiseで導きます。

choices.A: might
choices.B: must
choices.C: has
choices.D: will have

questions.translationJa: 研究室では光に敏感な材料を保管しています。日光が試料を傷める恐れがあるため、窓は覆われています。
questions.explanationJa: 避けたい可能性をfor fear that＋mightで表します。

questions.prompt: Several participants have requested subtitles. ------- this feedback, the media team will caption every training video.

choices.A: In case
choices.B: Otherwise
choices.C: Supposing
choices.D: Given

questions.translationJa: 複数の参加者が字幕を求めています。この意見を考慮し、メディアチームはすべての研修動画に字幕を付けます。
questions.explanationJa: 現に寄せられた意見を考慮するためGivenです。

questions.prompt: The equipment room may remain unlocked during setup ------- a staff member stays inside.

choices.A: in case
choices.B: as long as
choices.C: otherwise
choices.D: supposing

questions.translationJa: 職員が中にいる限り、設営中は機材室を施錠しなくても構いません。

questions.prompt: The launch plan assumes stable demand. ------- orders suddenly triple, which supplier could increase capacity fastest?

choices.C: Otherwise
